summary: Single Ecocounter piezo (counter 235) on the Chippendale Way shared path, 2018-06 to 2023-12; it reads cleanly until Aug 2021 (no single channel record above 36 in 15 minutes), and the automatic zero_outage fixes (Sep-Nov 2020, Apr 2022, May-Jul 2022, Jun-Jul 2023) and duplicate_record fixes look right. From Sep 2021 (North) and Oct 2022 (South) the counter has intermittent false-trigger bursts: one channel records 40 to 1105 in a single 15-minute slot, clustered at the same time of day for weeks, inflating some weeks up to 7x (e.g. North week of 2023-03-27: 11166 vs about 1500), so every day with such a burst is set missing for that direction (188 direction-days, worst Jan-Apr 2023). The step up in North from Oct 2021 (N/S ratio 0.75 to about 0.93 on clean days, with normal commute peaks) is kept as real post-lockdown change; there is one counter and no shared sites, so no series are defined.
